title: Sentiment sensing: comparative analysis of multilingual sentiment dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.01348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-country sentiment analysis faces three fundamental challenges: language-specific biases distort comparisons, compositional data constraints invalidate standard statistics and temporal dynamics lack rigorous testing frameworks. We introduce sentiment sensing, a framework that addresses these gaps through integrated statistical methods. By combining compositional data analysis, functional data methods, and non-parametric inference, sentiment sensing enables valid multilingual comparisons and statistically defensible detection of sentiment shifts. Our framework has been tested in two case studies, analyzing news articles from the 27 countries of the European Union on the topics of energy and artificial intelligence. Sentiment sensing focuses on multilingual sentiment analysis enabling rigorous comparative science.

translated_title: 情感感知：多语言情感动态的比较分析
translated_abstract: 跨国情感分析面临三个根本性挑战：特定语言的偏差会扭曲比较结果，成分数据的约束使标准统计方法失效，以及时间动态缺乏严格的检验框架。我们提出了“情感感知”，这是一个通过整合统计方法来弥补这些不足的框架。通过结合成分数据分析、函数型数据方法和非参数推断，情感感知能够实现有效的多语言比较，并对情感变化进行具有统计学依据的检测。我们的框架已在两个案例研究中得到验证，分析了欧盟27个国家关于能源和人工智能主题的新闻文章。情感感知专注于多语言情感分析，支持严谨的比较科学研究。
tldr: 该论文提出“情感感知”框架，通过整合成分数据分析、函数型数据方法和非参数推断，解决了跨国多语言情感分析中的语言偏差、成分数据约束和时间动态检验三大难题，并在欧盟27国关于能源与人工智能的新闻数据上得到验证。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "sentiment sensing," a statistical framework integrating compositional data analysis, functional data methods, and non-parametric inference to overcome language-specific biases, compositional data constraints, and untested temporal dynamics in cross-country sentiment analysis, validated on news from 27 EU countries covering energy and artificial intelligence.
